name: io.github.falsalama/proper-job
title: Proper Job Building Cost Calculator
description: Free UK building-cost estimates, US beta estimates and scenario comparisons. No account needed.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.estimateBasis: Indicative residential building budgets from supplied scope, with assumptions, exclusions and country-specific tax treatment; not fixed contractor quotes.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.dataAccess: Conversation inputs and public pricing policy only. No saved projects, customer accounts, exact addresses, drawings or payments.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.ui: Optional interactive result card for hosts supporting MCP Apps.
